title: Surviving Payee's Entitlement in a Joint Deposit — Ashgrove Income Annuity Joint Survivor Tiers
content:
On the Ashgrove Income Annuity Joint 50% Survivor and Joint 100% Survivor tiers of Income Annuities, the survivor's entitlement for the payment date of a deposit — the deposit concerned being the installment most recently issued on the contract — is set by comparing the deposit with the survivor installment now on the contract (the current installment on the contract record):

- **Deposit paid at more than the survivor installment now on the contract:** the survivor's entitlement is the tier's survivor continuation percentage of the deposit, rounded to the cent (50% on Joint 50% Survivor, 100% on Joint 100% Survivor).
- **Deposit paid at no more than that survivor installment:** the whole deposit is the survivor's entitlement.

On the other tiers neither rule applies.

### Comparisons (hypothetical)

| Tier | Deposit | Survivor installment now on the contract | Survivor's entitlement |
|---|---|---|---|
| Joint 50% Survivor | $3,000.00 | $1,500.00 | 50% of $3,000.00, that is $1,500.00 |
| Joint 50% Survivor | $1,500.00 | $1,500.00 (equal, so no more than it) | $1,500.00, the whole deposit |
| Joint 50% Survivor | $2,345.67 | $1,172.84 | $1,172.835, so $1,172.84 |
| Joint 100% Survivor | $2,000.00 | $1,900.00 | 100% of $2,000.00, that is $2,000.00 |
